title: Brazil IBGE Geodemographics, GDP, CNAE & GeoJSON Input

mode.title: Dataset Mode
mode.description: Select municipalities catalog, estimated population, municipal GDP (PIB), CNAE 2.3 classes, or official GeoJSON boundary mesh.

uf.title: State Acronym (UF)
uf.description: Optional 2-letter Brazilian state code (e.g. AL, SP, RJ, MG, BA). Resolves state boundaries and city lists automatically.

ibgeIds.title: IBGE Territory Codes (6/7 digits)
ibgeIds.description: Optional list of 7-digit municipality IBGE codes (e.g. 2704302 for Maceio, 3550308 for Sao Paulo).

query.title: Search Query (Municipality or Industry Keyword)
query.description: Optional case-insensitive filter across city names, CNAE descriptions, or regions.

quality.title: GeoJSON Mesh Resolution
quality.description: Boundary geometry detail level for geojson_mesh mode.
